sentences.text: Mr. Mukherjee, learned advocate appearing for the  petitioner submits that Co-ordinate Benches have  directed payment of compensation to the persons whose  property was utilized for the purpose of the said project.

He further submits that the petitioner is similarly situated Shib Chandra Ray Chaudhury Trust Estate vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198486716/
1  with that of the other petitioners in whose favour direction  for payment of compensation was passed by Co-ordinate  Benches.
 2  The learned advocate appearing for the State submits that the incomplete copy of the writ petition has been served upon the respondent.

opennyai_summary.arguments:

Mr. Mukherjee, learned advocate appearing for the  petitioner submits that Co-ordinate Benches have  directed payment of compensation to the persons whose  property was utilized for the purpose of the said project.

1  with that of the other petitioners in whose favour direction  for payment of compensation was passed by Co-ordinate  Benches.
 2  The learned advocate appearing for the State submits that the incomplete copy of the writ petition has been served upon the respondent.
Faced with such situation Mr. Mukherjee, learned advocate appearing for the petitioner supplies a complete copy of the writ petition upon the learned advocate for the State.
The Special Land Acquisition Officer, North 24 Parganas being the 4th respondent is directed to file a report in the form of an affidavit with regard to the allegations contained in the writ petition specifically stating as to whether the plots of land of the petitioner was the subject matter of the aforesaid requisition proceeding and/or the same was utilized for the said project.
